description:
What changed on a core model between two majors - the fields ADDED and REMOVED going
    from `from_major` to `to_major` (supports 17→18, 18→19, 19→20 and composed jumps such as
    17→20). Use this
    when writing or porting a module for a target version so you keep the fields that still
    exist and stop using the ones that were dropped. READ-ONLY.
name: odoo_version_diff
